name: spider-particles
title: Spider Particles
description: Canvas particle network background with connecting lines and mouse-driven repulsion.

props.name: particleCount
props.description: Controls how many particles are drawn.

props.name: gridGap
props.description: Switches to a spaced lattice when above zero.

props.name: particleSize
props.description: Makes each dot larger or smaller.

props.name: mouseConnectDist
props.description: Sets the web connection radius around the cursor.

props.name: showWeb
props.description: Turns the connection lines on or off.

props.name: particlesGlow
props.description: Enables glow rendering for particles and cursor points.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Glow color used when particle glow is enabled.
